blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Computing systems mein bunyadi qanooni (legal) aur akhlaqi (ethical) pehlu samajh sakenge.
Digital mahaul mein privacy (zaati maloomat ki hifazat) aur security ke mukhtalif khatre (threats) pehchan sakenge.
Security khatron ko rokne aur unka nuqsan kam karne (mitigating) ki hikmat-e-amli (strategies) samjha sakenge.
Digital divide (technology tak pahunch ka farq) aur mukhtalif samaji groups par iske asraat par baat kar sakenge.
Computing systems mein bias (janibdari) pehchan kar usay door kar sakenge.
Maloomat (information) ko mehfooz aur zimmedari se istemal kar sakenge.
Afraad aur muashre (society) par computing ke asar ka jaiza le sakenge.
Digital citizenship (internet par achha shehri hona) aur akhlaqi rawayye (ethical conduct) ke usool apna sakenge.

blocks.text: Aaj ki digital duniya mein computing systems hamari zindagi ke har hisse mein bara kirdar ada karte hain, apne phone aur laptop se le kar bare networks tak. Jab yeh systems hamari rozana zindagi ka hissa bante ja rahe hain, to in ke istemal se jure legal (qanooni) aur ethical (akhlaqi, yaani sahi aur ghalat ke) pehlu samajhna zaroori hai. Yeh chapter digital technology ke kai pehlu batata hai: terms of use, privacy aur security ke khatre, aur digital divide. Computing ke qanooni aur akhlaqi masail mein data protection (data ki hifazat), intellectual property rights (kisi ki banai hui cheez par us ka haq) aur mutalliqa qanoon ki pabandi shamil hain. Akhlaqi pehlu privacy, fairness (insaf) aur muashre par technology ke bare asar se mutalliq hain.

“Terms of Use” ko Terms and Conditions ya Terms of Service bhi kehte hain. Yeh legal agreements (qanooni muahide) hain jo batate hain ke koi service ya product kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh terms provider (jaise website, app ya software company) banata hai aur user ko inhein maanna (agree karna) parta hai. Maqsad yeh hai ke provider aur user ka rishta fair (munsifana) aur transparent (saaf aur khula) ho, aur dono apne rights (huqooq) aur obligations (zimmedariyan) samjhein.

Misalein: Jab aap Gmail jaisi email service par sign up karte hain to aap ko Google ki Terms of Use maanni parti hain. Yeh batati hain ke aap apna email account kaise istemal kar sakte hain, kis qism ka content share karna mana hai, aur Google aap ka personal data kaise sambhalta hai. Isi tarah Daraz jaisa Pakistani online shopping platform istemal karte waqt us ki Terms of Use mein payment ke tareeqon, return policy (cheez wapas karne ke qawaid) aur delivery ke tareeqe ki clauses (shartein) ho sakti hain, ta ke customer ko pata ho ke use kya milega aur us se kya tawaqqo ki jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Terms of Use kaun banata hai aur kaun maanta hai?
blocks.explanation: Service ka provider (website, app ya software company) banata hai; service istemal karne ke liye user ko inhein maanna (agree karna) parta hai.

items: Computing ke qanooni aur akhlaqi pehlu: data protection, intellectual property, qanoon ki pabandi, privacy aur insaf.
Terms of Use = Terms and Conditions = Terms of Service: provider ke banaye qanooni muahide jo user maanta hai (Gmail, Daraz).
